Card Q&A.q: If I don't play a Digimon card, can the part after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect activate?

Card Q&A.a: "When [...] would leave the battle area other than by battle" refers to when that Digimon is placed in the trash other than as a result of a battle, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's "when [...] would leave the battle area other than by [...] a battle" mean, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, all of those Digimon are prevented from leaving. This card's [All Turns] effect affects all Digimon without having to choose them. In such cases, the effect triggers once when multiples of your Digimon with the [Angel], [Archangel], or [Three Great Angels] trait would leave the battle area at the same time other than by one of your effects or a battle, and by trashing the top card of your security stack, all of those Digimon are prevented from leaving.
Card Q&A.q: If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiples of my Digimon with the [Angel], [Archangel], or [Three Great Angels] trait would leave the battle area at the same time other than by one of my effects or a battle, are all of those Digimon prevented from leaving?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Search your security stack. You may play 1 level 5 or lower [Angel] or [Archangel] trait Digimon card among it without paying the cost. Then, shuffle it, and 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn.

[All Turns] When one of your Digimon with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait would leave the battle area other than by one of your effects or a battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent them from leaving.
